shown_riddles: I am the creator, through thick and thin, My time is sunset then I begin. Worlds of men and beasts I make, to me these things are not fake. But Over and over I will kill , I am the tirent and creator but not at will. What am I?
A father's child, a mother's child, yet no one's son. Who am I.
The more you take, the more you leave behind. What are they?
You heard me before, Yet you hear me again. Then I die, 'Til you call me again What am I?
